verdict.rationale: An agentic desktop IDE could plausibly publish official SDKs, such as a plugin or automation SDK, so this axis applies. The evidence pack documents no official SDK. BYOK and custom-provider API styles concern which model endpoints the IDE consumes, not SDKs developers build against. Skills and plugins are in-app features with no developer SDK described. The OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
